output.sql: SELECT a.segment AS k, round(sum(d.amount_gross), 2) AS v FROM analytics.fct_invoices d JOIN analytics.dim_accounts a ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.issued BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2025-09-30' AND d.status = 'paid' GROUP BY k ORDER BY k

result.description: Gross billings: paid invoices before tax and discounts.

body.name: analytics-question
body.input: What was our headcount in Q3 2024?

result.name: dim_accounts
result.comment: One row per customer account: name, country code, segment (smb, mid, enterprise).

result.name: dim_plans
result.comment: Price list: monthly list price per plan.

result.name: fct_invoices
result.comment: Every invoice. status is paid, open, void or refunded; only paid invoices are revenue. amount_net is after tax and discounts, amount_gross before.

result.name: fct_subscriptions
result.comment: Subscriptions with start and end dates. Active subscription is not the same as an active customer; activity is logins in raw_events.

result.name: fct_support_tickets
result.comment: Support tickets. csat (1-5) is set when a ticket is closed and rated; report CSAT by closed date.

result.name: fct_usage_daily
result.comment: Daily usage per account: queries run and data scanned.

result.name: legacy_invoices
result.comment: Deprecated: the old billing system, stopped on 2025-06-30. Do not use; use fct_invoices or mart_revenue_daily.

result.name: mart_revenue_daily
result.comment: Revenue as finance reports it: net revenue per account per day, paid invoices only. Use this for revenue.

result.name: raw_events
result.comment: Product events per user. An active customer is an account with at least one 'login' event in the period.

result.name: stg_payments
result.comment: Staging: raw payment events. Contains retried payments, so the same invoice can appear twice. Do not sum without deduplicating.

result.name: tmp_revenue_backfill
result.comment: Temporary, partial backfill of daily revenue for a migration. Incomplete; do not use.

output.reply: I mean headcount the way the team tracks it.

result.name: event
result.comment: login, query, export, invite or dashboard_view.

output.text: I am not sure enough to answer this.

body.name: analytics-question
body.input: Give me revenue for Lumen Foods BV in February 2026.

output.sql: SELECT round(sum(d.net_revenue), 2) FROM analytics.mart_revenue_daily d WHERE d.day BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28' AND d.account_id = 589

result.description: Revenue as finance reports it: net of tax and discounts, paid invoices only, from the daily revenue mart.
